shows.title: 100 Rupay Ka Boyfriend, CEO Nikla
shows.description: A broke college girl hires a ‘100-rupee boyfriend’ for a fake relationship, only to discover he’s actually a secret multimillionaire CEO testing people’s intentions. As lies, love, and chaos collide, their small deal turns into a life-changing romance neither expected.

shows.title: 1000 Saal Ka Badla
shows.description: Karan Mehta 1000 saalon tak ek hi din ke time loop mein fasa raha. Usi ek din mein usne aisi fighting skills aur contacts bana liye the, jinhe haasil karna kisi aam insaan ke liye namumkin tha. Lekin woh apni maa ke kaatilon—sauteli maa Kamini, uske bete Ravi aur mastermind Mahesh Modi—se badla nahi le paaya. Duniya ki nazron mein woh ek spoiled brat ban chuka tha. Phir ek din woh us jaal se azaad ho gaya… par kya azaadi ke baad woh apna badla le paaya, ya kisi naye khel mein phas gaya?

shows.title: Waris Ki Wapasi
shows.description: When Priya returns home after 15 years, she brings with her the truth that can shake an empire. A story of identity, betrayal, and redemption—where every secret has a price. Watch Now !

shows.title: Game Changer
shows.description: To fulfill his grandfather’s dying wish, a secretive multi-billionaire lives undercover as a lowly toilet sweeper, navigating a contractual marriage to a struggling CEO while using his hidden influence and lethal skills to dismantle her corporate enemies and underworld threats.

shows.title: A Commando's Countdown To Reckoning.
shows.description: Shravan, a quiet ex-soldier carrying his fallen comrade Vikram’s ashes home, rescues a mother and child before being falsely arrested and humiliated by a corrupt cop. A young lawyer, Varsha, steps in, exposing police corruption and criminal networks. As Shravan’s true identity emerges, he confronts ruthless mafioso Daaga, restores a hero’s honour, and proves what real courage means.

shows.title: Time Travel MBBS
shows.description: The show Reborn 70 follows Nobel Prize–winning doctor Ziya Sharma, who dies in a bombing but is mysteriously reborn in the body of a disgraced village mother in 2032. With her medical knowledge and new identity, she must fight prejudice, protect two children who hate her, and prove herself while uncovering dark conspiracies against her.

shows.title: 3 Elder Brothers
shows.description: After Dumping That Scumbag, My Three Elder Brothers Spoil Me Like Crazy!

shows.title: 30 Din ki Aashiqui
shows.description: On a stormy night, wounded gangster Ranveer forces nurse Anika into a marriage at gunpoint and gives her 30 days to fall in love with him—or walk free. Trapped in his dangerous world, Anika plans to expose him, but slowly discovers his softer side. As her hatred turns into love and she learns she’s pregnant, Ranveer’s past returns, forcing her to leave. When truth finally comes out, love defeats fear—and they reunite.

shows.title: Sajan Ji Ghar Aaye
shows.description: After being betrayed on her wedding day, Avni’s life takes a drastic turn when Mayur, a humble tiffin delivery man with a hidden past, marries her to protect her dignity and fulfill her father’s last wish. What begins as a fake marriage slowly evolves into something deeper, as secrets, emotions, and truths begin to unfold. Watch Now!

shows.title: Gully Boy ki CEO love
shows.description: Set in the vibrant city of Varanasi, the story follows Aman, a simple desi saree salesman deeply rooted in the culture and spirit of Banaras, and Shaily, a modern, educated businesswoman who owns a leading Banarasi saree brand and shopping mall. Coming from completely different worlds, their journey unfolds through love, clashes, and emotions while celebrating the rich traditions, language, and colorful lifestyle of Banaras.

shows.title: Ultimate Protector
shows.description: A seemingly lowly tarot card reader, underestimated and divorced by his ambitious wife, reveals his hidden influence as the "Ultimate Protector" when he remarries a powerful pharmaceutical heiress and uses his secret connections to dominate the business world.

shows.title: Genius Delivery Boy
shows.description: A hidden billionaire living as a delivery man is betrayed and divorced by his ungrateful wife, leading him to reclaim his true identity as "Lord Singhania" to ruin his oppressors and find true love with a rival business tycoon.

shows.title: The CEO Became Gatekeeper Of Her World
shows.description: A powerful billionaire who falls in love with a girl  haunted by same mysterious one night stand with her but is played by her step sister takes responsibility with wrong woman, only to later discover the real woman he loved has become his fake wife—forcing him to hide his identity, earn her love without truth, and ultimately fight to reclaim both her trust and his own redemption.

shows.title: Aa Nimisham
shows.description:
A young man’s life changes forever after a tragic accident draws him into a mysterious household. As secrets, lies, and hidden motives unfold, he must confront love, betrayal, and his own haunted past.
Aa Nimisham is an emotional thriller where every moment holds a revelation — and nothing is as it seems.

shows.title: 7 Days To Erase You From My Heart
shows.description: Harsh apne pehle pyaar Jiya, jo cancer ke aakhri stage par thi, uski ‘aakhri khwahish’ poori karne ke liye usse sirf naam ki shaadi karta hai, jabki uska dil Sneha se juda hua tha. Sach jaane bina, Harsh aur Jiya ki badhti nazdeekiyan dekhkar Sneha toot gayi thi aur apni yaadein mitaane ka treatment karwaya tha. 7 din baad jab Harsh usse mila, Sneha use bhool chuki thi. Ab Harsh har ehsaas ke zariye apna pyaar phir se jagane ki koshish kar raha tha, lekin kya bhuli hui mohabbat laut paayegi?

shows.title: 7 Lifelines to cheat death
shows.description:
This show feels real because it speaks the language of Gen Z's struggles with unstable jobs, family pressure, loans, broken dreams, and emotional loneliness.
The hero isn’t powerful or privileged; he’s someone who keeps trying, failing, and still doesn’t give up.
Every life he lives reflects problems common people face but never talk about openly.
It’s not fantasy for the elite—it’s hope, pain, and survival for the everyday Indian.

shows.title: Mafia Baap
shows.description: After leaving behind his past as a deadly contract killer, a peaceful café owner is forced back into the underworld when his daughter is kidnapped by a brutal human trafficking syndicate, unleashing a father’s unstoppable war against the monsters who took his child.

shows.title: Big Bull Returns 2.0
shows.description: Kabir, once dismissed as weak, is secretly a powerful CEO betrayed by his ambitious wife Sonia, who falls for a conman, Sunny. As deception unravels, Kabir rises from humiliation to reclaim his identity, exposing lies and seeking justice with the help of Meghna, ultimately turning betrayal into a path of strength and redemption. Watch now.

shows.title: Tum Agar Saath Ho
shows.description: “Tum Agar Saath Ho” is a romantic drama about two middle-aged, unmarried individuals —Kabeer, a powerful yet emotionally distant businessman, and Tara, a kind but struggling woman who has been overlooked by society due to her age and speech impediment. When fate brings them together, they enter an unexpected marriage. Their journey explores love beyond age, status, and societal expectations, while hidden truths and family conflicts threaten to pull them apart. Watch now!

shows.title: The Challenger
shows.description: Sonia, a powerful CEO, shocks everyone by revealing her pregnancy with her lover Sunny, humiliating her husband Kabir. As Kabir is thrown out and branded impotent, he uncovers Sunny’s fraud and returns to expose the truth. In a dramatic showdown, Kabir reveals his real identity as a billionaire CEO, proves Sonia was never pregnant, and brings Sunny’s lies to light, reclaiming his dignity and choosing a new path. Watch now.

Shehzada Bina Taj Ka is a high-voltage corporate revenge drama about betrayal, greed, and comeback.
It's story of Akshay Sethi, a powerful businessman, who gets betrayed by his wife Kawya and business partner Nishant, they snatch his company and publicly humiliate him. Thrown out of his own empire, Akshay vows revenge and returns stronger to expose the conspirators and reclaim his legacy. Watch Now.

shows.description: Fated Flame is a show about a legendary agent forced into hiding is drawn back into the world of violence when her son’s passion for boxing collides with a deadly underworld syndicate. As secrets unravel, a mother must fight both enemies and fate to protect her family.

shows.title: Aakhri Udaan
shows.description: The show is an aviation thriller about Nishant, an Air Traffic Controller who saves a passenger flight by breaking protocol but is betrayed and framed by his wife and her lover. Disgraced and broken, Nishant is mysteriously given a second chance to relive the same day. This time, he lets the truth unfold, exposing the real culprits without losing his integrity. Starting afresh as a fighter pilot trainer, Nishant rebuilds his life, purpose, and faith. Watch now!

shows.title: Aashiqui Tum Se Hi
shows.description: After secretly donating a kidney to save the ungrateful woman he loves, a world-class chef hiding in plain sight as a lowly secretary must rise to global fame while enduring the ultimate betrayal—only to discover that his redemption comes with a heartbreaking final sacrifice.

shows.description: When seven successful siblings Aarav, Kabir, Vivaan, Raghav, Meera, Riya, and Ananya turn against their foster father Maheshwar Nath, believing shocking lies about their past, they destroy his life and careers in blind rage. But when the truth of betrayal surfaces, the family faces a storm of guilt, revenge, and redemption, testing the very meaning of blood and love. Watch Now!

His revival sparks his elder brother’s jealousy, twisting blood ties into rivalry. Between love, betrayal, and redemption, Accidental Shaadi explores how fate, family, and power collide in a battle of hearts and egos. Watch now.

shows.title: Daddy on Contract
shows.description: “A struggling actor pretends to be a successful superstar to protect his daughter’s pride, turning everyday life into a series of hilarious and emotional performances. But when truth and love collide, the biggest role of his life becomes being a real father.”

shows.title: Adha Pyar
shows.description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

shows.title: Adhuri Aashiqui
shows.description: A young couple’s marriage, once full of love, starts to fall apart under family pressure and personal conflicts, revealing that true commitment is about understanding, not just following rituals. Watch now.

What begins as a shocking revelation soon pulls her into a dark journey to uncover the truth about her real parents, Karthik and Kavita Verma, and a hidden past that threatens her very identity. With her best friend Saanvi Shukla and estranged sister Aadhya Kumari by her side, Kiara must decide where her true family lies in blood, or in love. Watch Now

shows.description: Once a legendary barrister, Anand Awasthi now roams the streets as a broken drunk, his past glory buried in shame and despair. Will this fallen lawyer rise again to deliver justice?

Separated by destiny, betrayal, and time, will Parth rise to become a powerful CEO or lose the one person who believed in him the most?

shows.title: All I want is…Tum

Through betrayal, danger, and emotional turmoil, Krish realizes Saniya is the girl he has been searching for all along—and love finally triumphs over every contract and condition.

shows.title: Aloo Bhindi Ka Pyaar
shows.description: In the dramatic "Sabzi Mandi," Aloo and Bhindi defy their traditional families and a jealous Gobi to protect their forbidden romance. Their journey leads them through a high-stakes vegetable courtroom and a stint in "Cold Storage" before proving their innocence. With the support of friends, they escape the label of being "rotten" to perform a sacred "Kadhai Marriage". Ultimately, their families unite, realizing their world-famous combo is powered by true love.

Raghav, once the most feared gangster of Mumbai, decides to leave the underworld after a tragic loss. But as rivals close in, allies turn traitors, and his own brother rises against him, Raghav must fight one last bloody battle—between the man he was and the man he wants to be.

shows.title: Ancient Appetites
shows.description:
What if your dusty shop became the last hope of a war-torn dynasty? A mysterious back door, ancient gold, and a soldier desperate to save his people—this is no ordinary retail drama.
Get ready for a gripping ride through time, trust, and tactical biscuits. Watch Now !

shows.title: Andha Cricketer
shows.description: This microdrama follows Victor Sethi, a star cricketer who is brutally blinded by his rival, Dushyant, only to resurface years later as a humble, blind sweeper named Vaibhav. When a struggling academy owned by Riya faces a hostile takeover, Victor is forced to reveal his superhuman "sound-based" batting skills to save her legacy. Amidst intense match-fixing and physical threats, he overcomes a rigged final match using a wooden staff to defeat Dushyant once and for all.

shows.title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
shows.description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

shows.title: Game Over
shows.description: Game Over is the gripping journey of Bhavna, an innocent, kind-hearted orphan who is betrayed by her adopted rich family the Singhanias. From being humiliated and disowned to rising as a world-famous Master Healer, Bhavna’s path crosses again with her first love, Karan Thakkar, a powerful billionaire. Love, revenge, and redemption intertwine as the unknown girl becomes the billionaire’s bride proving that true worth shines beyond wealth and bloodlines.

shows.title: Arabpati Kissan
shows.description: A simple, hardworking farmer becomes a national sensation when his honesty, courage, and sharp wit expose corruption in politics and business. As he rises from ordinary man to unexpected hero, he proves that true power lies not in money—but in integrity.

shows.title: Arranged to Love
shows.description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

shows.title: Asli Desi Billionaire
shows.description: A secret billionaire hides his identity and works as a peon in the US to uncover discrimination against Indians. When he becomes a woman’s fake boyfriend, real feelings emerge—until his true wealth and power threaten to destroy everything they built.

shows.title: Asli Fighter
shows.description: Betrayed and left for dead by his best friend , Grandmaster Arjun resurfaces as a memory-impaired janitor for a struggling fight club. His legendary instincts return as he defends his new family against the Solanki clan , eventually regaining his memory during a high-stakes championship. Arjun exposes the traitors who stole his throne , defeats the mastermind Agastya , and reclaims his title as the rightful Fighter Champion

On the very night the company becomes number one, he walks away with truth that power without respect is destined to fall.

As his ex-wife, former family, and rivals mock him, Yatin exposes his true identity, topples the powerful Kotharis, and shocks everyone. But a devastating claim about his daughter’s paternity threatens to destroy everything he fought to reclaim.

Watch Now

As secrets unravel, betrayal, pride, and power collide in a dramatic confrontation that changes everyone's fate.

After years of heartbreak and betrayal, Raj finally decides to walk away but this broken house husband is not as powerless as everyone believes, and his revenge is about to destroy the world.

shows.title: One Last Chance

One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

shows.title: Bechare Raja Sahab
shows.description: A devoted father, Raj, is humiliated for his modest life—until the shocking truth reveals he is actually Prince Singhai, a powerful business tycoon. As he secretly supports his wife Latika’s success while hiding his identity, betrayal, ego, and love collide, pushing their relationship to the edge of divorce.

shows.title: THE LOVE AFFAIR
shows.description: Love Affair is a story about two lovebirds who fight the world in the name of love.

shows.title: Beghar Raja
shows.description:
A prince framed for his own brother’s murder is forced to live as a beggar. A princess chooses him against the world. And when betrayal rises from within his own family, the fallen heir must return, not for the throne, but for justice.
But can a “beggar king” survive the war waiting for him? Watch now!

shows.title: Beloved Darling: The CEO's Wife and Genius Baby
shows.description: Beloved Darling: The CEO's Wife and Genius Baby tells the story of a young CEO's wife who must navigate the complexities of family, love, and business. With the help of her exceptionally gifted child, she faces challenges that could either tear them apart or bring them closer as a family.

shows.title: Benaam Baap
shows.description: A wealthy businessman, Abhilash Singhania, loses his memory after nearly drowning while saving his son. Presumed dead, he starts a new life as a humble hotel worker, unknowingly serving his own family years later. Raised by him, an orphan girl Shikha becomes his emotional anchor. Meanwhile, his son Vihaan—now the hotel owner—mistreats him under manipulation and misunderstanding. As fragments of memory resurface and family paths cross, the story builds toward an emotional reunion.

shows.title: Bend the waist
shows.description: Bend the waist

shows.title: Bloodline Betrayal
shows.description: Bloodline Betrayal is a suspenseful romantic drama about love, trust, and shocking secrets. Rhea, who wakes up from a two-year coma, finds her world shattered—her husband married to her best friend and her identity almost erased. As she pieces her life back together, betrayal turns into vengeance, and love into a dangerous game where nothing is as it seems.

shows.title: Betrayal Ke Baad
shows.description: A wealthy but secretive businessman, Rohit returns to India to reunite with his longtime fiancée, only to be humiliated and rejected because of his “low status.” At the same time, ambitious CEO Shanaya Mittal crosses paths with him during a business crisis, leading to a chaotic fake-marriage proposal, corporate rivalry, and betrayal.

shows.title: Broken Vows
shows.description: Akash marries Mansi believing love can change fate—only to become invisible in his own marriage. Humiliated, replaced, and broken, he walks away in silence… unaware that destiny is about to make him the most powerful man in the room.

shows.title: Bezubaan Waris
shows.description: Arundhati, once heir to a grand mansion, is silenced by betrayal and forced to live as a servant while her uncle and cousin steal her life. Her only ally, Adi, hides his true identity - her childhood fiancé and a billionaire, living in disguise to protect her. Together they shatter the web of lies, awaken her lost voice, and reunite her with her father, who rises from a sixteen-year coma to see his daughter reclaim her destiny. Watch now!

shows.title: Bhaag Arjun Bhaag
shows.description: When dreams crash, only courage runs faster. Arjun, once a national sprinting sensation, falls from glory due to betrayal and misfortune. As he cleans the floors of the very academy he once dreamt of ruling, his ex-best friend Karan basks in stolen fame, until fate challenges both again in a race that’s not just about speed, but redemption. Watch Now!

shows.title: Bhai Ka Badla
shows.description: Kartik arrives into the family of Vivan, his sister Shivika and Dadaji, claiming that Kartik’s dad died saving Vivan when he was in a fatal accident with his parents, many years ago. Out of a sense of responsibility Shivika and dadaji decide to adopt Kartik but Vivan soon realises Kartik has ulterior motives. Kartik wants to oust Vivan from his own home and become the undeniable variz of the family.

shows.title: Bhaijaan
shows.description: A brutally injured young man, Kian, rises from near death to infiltrate Mumbai’s deadliest gang, seeking revenge for his family’s murder only to discover that the woman he trusts and serves is the very mastermind behind his destruction.

shows.title: Bhatiji Ki Dost, CEO Ki Deewangi
shows.description: “A simple, innocent girl becomes the obsession of a powerful and emotionally damaged CEO after she saves him in an unexpected moment. Torn between her loyalty to her best friend and his uncontrollable passion, their lives collide in a storm of love, madness, and dangerous desire.”

shows.title: Bhikari Raja
shows.description: The beggar king found his bride… but the palace walls are closing in with lies, poison, and power. Who survives the final blow? Watch now!

shows.title: Bhikhari Bana Jadugar
shows.description: A broken man is granted a second chance by a mysterious beggar, only to realize that the true miracle was never wealth—but the transformation of his own soul.

shows.title: Bhikhari Fighter
shows.description: A fearless martial arts master lives as a beggar, hiding his legendary past. When love and honor drag him back into the fighting world, enemies rise and secrets explode. Betrayal, destiny, and raw power collide as he reclaims his true identity as the Grandmaster. Watch now.

shows.title: Big Boss Daddy
shows.description: Deepak Sharma desh ke sabse ameer logon mein se ek the, lekin apne bacchon ko paison ki asli keemat sikhane ke liye woh parivaar ke saath gaon mein gareeb bankar rehte the. Jab unke bacchon ko ek reality show ke liye chuna gaya, to papa ko electric scooter dilane ke junoon ki wajah se baccho ne usme hissa lene ka faisla kiya. Lekin Mehra family ne TRP ke liye bacchon par zulm karne shuru kar diye.aakhirkar Deepak Sharma ko saamne aana hi pada..kya gareebi ka yeh natak unpar hi bhaari pad gaya?

shows.title: Big Fat Love
shows.description: Love, Lies & Payback

shows.title: Billion Dollar Love
shows.description: A struggling event planner is forced into a marriage with a man she believes to be a poor ex-convict, only to discover he is a secret billionaire. Between betrayal, power games, and unexpected romance, their fiery bond challenges fate and family.

shows.title: Billion Dollar Wali Galti
shows.description: When airline tycoon Veer Chopra falls for the charming flight attendant Lara Smith, he thinks he has found his perfect match. But when his unsuspecting parents, Rajesh and Vinita Chopra, fly in to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deception, and humiliation unfolds mid-air turning love into the costliest mistake of Veer’s life.

shows.title: Billion Dollar Wala Revenge
shows.description: When a powerful tycoon freezes his sons’ fortunes, calm and principled Prithvi chooses dignity and hard work while his jealous brother Harsh chooses revenge. A contract marriage with fiery CEO Ragini pulls Prithvi into a web of corporate sabotage, betrayal, and a deadly conspiracy. As poison, greed, and attempted murder shatter the Diwaan empire, Prithvi must rise from ruin to expose the truth. But in the battle for legacy and love, who will truly win his heart? Watch now.

shows.title: International School of Blunders
shows.description: Trying to get admission for their son in the most elite school of Delhi, a billionaire's family is unknowingly insulted and bullied by the principal and rich parents of other spoilt students. What follows is a story of sweet revenge where elitism and nepotism are brought down and social justice is restored.

shows.title: Billionaire Baap Ka Badla
shows.description: "Billionaire Baap Ka Badla" is a story of a poor young man unknowingly works inside the empire that once abandoned him. Betrayed by love and robbed of his invention, he is publicly humiliated. At the moment of his lowest fall, fate reveals he is the lost heir to a powerful dynasty. Watch Now.

shows.title: Billionaire Bana Bodyguard
shows.description: The billionaire became a bodyguard just to find true love! When identities switched, love's true face was revealed!

shows.title: Billionaire Bank Chor
shows.description: When billionaire Dharam Khurana loses everything—including the love of his life—in a tragic twist, he’s pushed to the edge. Desperate to save her, he storms into his own bank to withdraw his locked fortune, only to be branded a fraud. What begins as a simple plea for help turns into a high-stakes heist filled with humiliation, revenge, and redemption.

shows.title: Ba****d Billionaire
shows.description:
“Kya khoon ka rishta hi sab kuch hota hai? Ya insaaniyat aur pyaar bhi parivaar bana sakte hain?”

Raj Chaudhary, the adopted son of a billionaire grows up craving love, only to face humiliation, betrayal, and rejection at every step. Stripped of dignity, power, and wealth, he chooses love with Anushka over the empire. But the war isn’t just outside, it’s within his own bloodline. Secrets, frauds, and conspiracies shake the Chaudhary dynasty until one explosive truth shatters everything: Raj is not adopted… he is the real heir. Watch Now!

shows.title: Billionaire Bhikari
shows.description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Bhikari is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

shows.title: Billionaire Biwi Betrayal
shows.description: Aarav Malhotra and Meera Kapoor seemed to have it all a loving marriage, thriving careers, and a future full of promise. But beneath the perfect facade lie unspoken resentments, buried secrets, and choices that slowly chip away at their bond. When one devastating truth comes to light, their world unravels, forcing them to face the question is love enough to survive the wreckage? Watch Now!

shows.title: Billionaire Boyfriend Ka Badla
shows.description: Set against the glamorous yet cut-throat world of aviation and corporate empires, The Sky Between Us is a high-octane romantic thriller that begins with a chance meeting on a flight from Dubai to Mumbai and soars into a battle of egos, love, and legacy.

shows.title: Secret Shaadi
shows.description: Varsh Marwa, heir to a powerful business empire, refuses to become CEO and goes undercover as a peon in his family’s failing Bastar coal company. There, he joins Bhavya, a poor but honest girl, to expose deep-rooted corruption and a coal mafia. Forced into a secret contract marriage to save Bhavya, Varsh hides his identity until it’s revealed at an international summit—uncovering betrayal within his own family and turning his mission into a fight for love, truth, and redemption.

shows.title: Billionaire Daddy on Duty
shows.description: A ruthless corporate conspiracy, a night of betrayal, and a child born in tragedy bind two strangers together until a billionaire CEO disguises himself as a labourer and unknowingly steps into his own past, becoming a “rent-a-dad” to the son who might actually be his.

shows.title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
shows.description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

shows.title: Billionaire Groom Returns
shows.description: Watch This special Series "Billionaire Groom Returns" Now!

shows.title: Billionaire Heroine Ka Comeback
shows.description: Drishti, a famous screenwriter who hid her identity to marry Naitik. Treated like an unpaid maid and framed by his sister-in-law, she finally accepts a divorce. Reclaiming her status as a powerful heiress, Drishti returns to the spotlight to adapt her hit story for the big screen. As she rises, her past and present collide in a high-stakes tale of revenge and redemption.

shows.title: Billionaire Hua Kangal
shows.description: Living off lies and loans, a show-off “billionaire” family sees its perfect world collapse when one card decline exposes their fake fortune—dragging them from ameeri to gareebi overnight.

shows.title: Billionaire Ka IVF Ishq
shows.description: A rich billionaire who does not believe in marriage agrees to have a child through IVF to protect his legacy. What starts as a practical decision soon turns into a tough journey filled with family pressure, lies, danger, and unexpected emotions. As love enters his life, he must choose between power, reputation, and the woman carrying his child. Billionaire Ka IVF Ishq is a gripping story of a man forced to fight for his family and future.

shows.title: Billionaire Ka MMS
shows.description: “Billionaire Ka MMS” is a gripping corporate thriller that unfolds in real time on the day before a billion-dollar IPO. At the heart of it stands Neel Pradhan, a brilliant but broken fintech CEO whose arrogance, trauma, and moral decay spiral into chaos when a scandalous MMS from his past surfaces during his live IPO announcement.

shows.title: Billionaire ka Private Jet
shows.description: A woman is humiliated for “not belonging” on a private jet. What no one knows is that the jet belongs to her brother. As arrogance meets reality, one revelation turns power, pride, and privilege upside down—proving that the biggest mistake was underestimating a billionaire.

shows.title: Billionaire ka Safar
shows.description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

shows.title: Secret Raat
shows.description: In Billionaire Ki Legacy, Meri Kokh Se Shuru Hui, the fate of the powerful Mehta Empire rests on unexpected shoulders. Anaya, a simple yet determined woman, finds herself entangled in the lives of Samar Mehta, the heir to a vast fortune, Kabir, her past love with disruptive ambitions, and Sonia, the cunning rival who will stop at nothing for power. As secrets, betrayal, and love collide, Anaya’s womb becomes the beginning of a legacy that could redefine the empire’s future. Watch Now!

shows.title: Billionaire Ki Poti
shows.description: When kind-hearted schoolteacher Vedika unknowingly marries Shaurya Khurana, the arrogant and spoiled heir of a billionaire empire, she expects a normal life but ends up at the center of a storm. As family secrets unravel and Shaurya’s past clashes with Vedika’s values, love is tested in a world where wealth hides wounds, and the truth could break them or bring them closer than ever. Watch Now!

shows.title: Waaris Par Bawaal
shows.description: A ruthless billionaire, Nutan Kharbanda, forces a poor young woman, Divya, into surrogacy to secure a family heir, exploiting her mother’s illness. Inside the mansion, Divya faces humiliation, betrayal, and deadly conspiracies. As truth unfolds, love grows between Divya and Ranveer, exposing lies, punishing evil, and turning a cruel contract into justice and redemption.

shows.title: Billionaire Lover Returns
shows.description: A poor but spirited girl dies saving a billionaire and is mysteriously brought back to life a year before her death—with a choice between wealth or her memories. When fate reunites her with the same man, love, revenge, and celestial magic collide in a thrilling battle between destiny and desire.

shows.title: Billionaire Maa ka Gareeb Beta
shows.description: While fleeing from goons trying to kill her, billionaire businesswoman Meera is forced to hand over her infant son to a poor farmer to save his life. The child grows up as Vikram, raised with love, dignity, and hardship. Years later, fate brings Meera back to the village, only to mistake another boy for her lost son. As greed, lies, and power clash, the real son must fight not just for his identity, but for the values his poor father gave him.

shows.title: Billionaire on Plane
shows.description: Billionaire who owns the aircraft boards his own plane in a mechanic's uniform to identify why customers are not complaining so much about the airline. He gets treated badly, until the staff finds out who he is.

shows.title: Billionaire Overnight
shows.description: Ek aam insaan ki zindagi ek raat mein palat jaati hai jab usse daulat, shauhrat aur taqat milti hai. Lekin naye rishton aur dushmanon ke beech, usse faisla karna hai ki asli khushi paison mein hai ya pyar mein .

shows.title: Billionaire Pohawala
shows.description: When Ethan D’Costa, an impoverished tea seller, makes a Faustian bargain with a secret group who worship a demon to give his daughter the life she deserves, he rises overnight to unimaginable wealth and power. But as his past, his estranged wife, and the ruthless Poonawala empire resurface, Ethan must fight to protect his daughter at all costs—before the demon returns to claim his soul. Watch Now.

shows.title: Billionaire Lost Waris
shows.description: “A poor, heartbroken girl’s life changes when a mysterious billionaire singer saves her and brings her into his world of fame, danger, and desire. As hidden enemies and dark secrets surface, their unexpected bond becomes a battle between love, power, and survival.”

shows.title: Billionaire Sautela Bhai
shows.description: Arjun Purohit a wronged son cast out as an illegitimate child  rises from betrayal and humiliation to reclaim his father’s billion dollar empire. But as he faces his cunning stepbrother Kunal and manipulative stepmother Ishita, revenge becomes the only inheritance he’s willing to claim.

shows.title: Badnaam Billionaire
shows.description: Billionaire Scam Bride tells the thrilling story of Zara, a con artist who marries tech billionaire Aryan Malhotra under false pretenses - only to find herself falling for him. When lies start to unravel and Aryan discovers her secret, Zara must choose between running away with the fortune or staying to fight for the love she never meant to find.

shows.title: Billionaire Shehzada
shows.description: Aryan Khanna kuch saal pehle apni gareeb aur budhi maa, apne bade bhai aur apne pyaar ko chhodkar gaon se shehar naukri karne chala gaya tha. Lekin jab woh wapas lauta, toh sab kuch badal chuka tha. Bade-bade businessman uske saamne sar jhukane lage the, aur khaufnaak gunde bhi uski ek nazar se kaanp jaate the. Paisa ab uske liye koi maayne nahi rakhta tha. Par sawaal ye tha — kya yeh sirf kangali se kamyabi ki dastaan thi? Ya iske peeche chhupa tha koi aisa raaz, jo sabko hila kar rakh de?

shows.title: Billionaire’s Broken Granddaughter
shows.description: The Billionaire’s Divorced Granddaughter is a gripping revenge-romance about betrayal, identity, and power. Namit Jain, left for dead in a plane crash and abandoned by his wife Akansha, rises from humiliation to reclaim his true legacy as the heir of the Jain Empire. As love turns to vengeance and secrets unravel, the battle between the Bansals and the Jains explodes into a storm of wealth, pride, and shattered hearts.

shows.title: Billionaire's Homecoming
shows.description: Devansh Chaudhary Shivgarh ke ek chhote se gaon mein pala-badha tha, lekin waqt ke saath woh ek bahut bada businessman ban gaya tha. Gaonwalon ka ehsaan chukane ke liye woh har saal karodon rupaye Shivgarh bhejta tha, taaki wahan development ho aur logon ki zindagi behtar ban sake. Lekin jab woh ek aam aadmi bankar gaon lauta, to sach dekhkar hairaan reh gaya—gaon ab bhi gareebi aur badhaali mein jee raha tha. Devansh ne corruption ke peeche chhupe logon ko saza dene ki thaan li.

shows.title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London
shows.description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.

shows.title: Ultimate Divorce
shows.description: Billionaire’s Tallaq is a gripping romance-drama of mistaken identities, betrayal, and second chances. Vaidehi, a struggling village girl, unknowingly becomes the secret wife of billionaire heir Armaan Sharma after saving his life, only for him to abandon her and flee abroad. Five years later, when fate brings them face to face again, lies, misunderstandings, and love collide—forcing them into a dangerous game of marriage, divorce, and destiny.

shows.title: Billionaire's Unknown Son
shows.description: Mihir sacrifices his childhood for his mother… 20 years later, Tina betrays his love, and fate brings Ragini back for revenge.

shows.title: Cheater Billionaire
shows.description: Girdhar Balwani, a star insurance agent, secretly runs a crore-rupee scam using fake policies on vulnerable people. When colleague Ramesh discovers this, Girdhar murders him. As ASP Ajay Sinha investigates—complicated by his engagement to Girdhar's crush Mohini—the agent manipulates everyone. But Jishina Mandal, whose father was a victim, uncovers the truth and brings him to justice.

shows.title: Black Day : The Untold Stories
shows.description: Black Day: Untold Stories of 1975 is a gripping political drama that uncovers the dark and untold realities of India’s Emergency era, where fear, power, censorship, and resistance changed the fate of a nation forever.

shows.title: Black Mine's Hidden Dragon
shows.description:
Black Mine's Hidden Dragon" is a gripping show set in a remote coal town where a mysterious newcomer exposes buried secrets and power struggles.
As tension builds between miners and corrupt officials, hidden identities come to light.
A tale of revenge, redemption, and resilience unfolds in under ten minutes.

shows.title: Blacklisted Wife
shows.description: A hardened army officer strikes a deal with a suicidal, blacklisted girl to become his fake wife, but as suspicion grows that she may be a spy from his past, their contract marriage turns into a dangerous game of trust, identity, and forbidden love.

shows.title: Blind Love Deadly Truth
shows.description: After losing his eyesight in an accident, billionaire Karan Malhotra is abandoned by his girlfriend and pushed to the edge of despair. Aradhya, a strong-willed woman hiding her own powerful identity, saves him and agrees to a contract marriage to become his “eyes.” As Karan battles betrayal, a murderous stepbrother, and corporate conspiracies within Malhotra Jewels, the fake marriage slowly turns into real love while buried secrets about Aradhya, their past, and their child begin to surface.

shows.title: Blood, Lies and Secrets
shows.description: Siddharth apni adopted behen Zara ke pyaar mein itna andha hai ki usse apni saggi behen Ruhi dikhayi hi nahi deti. Lekin ek accident ke baad uske guilt aur uski zindagi mein aisa toofan aata hai jo sab kuch badal deta hai. Uss accident ke baad jab police Ruhi ki maut ko ek saazish batati hai, Ruhi ki atma sach dikhane wapas aati hai. Zara ke innocence ke peeche chhupa hai ek dangerous game of lies, betrayal and revenge. Kya Siddharth Zara ka sach payega? Ya ek aur maut ko anjam degi Zara.

shows.description: Micro drama

shows.title: Blunder on Ship
shows.description: After hiring a seemingly ordinary bartender to pose as her "rented husband" to escape a predatory business merger, a struggling CEO discovers her fake spouse is actually the reclusive "Ocean King"—a billionaire tycoon who begins secretly using his vast empire to dismantle her enemies and turn their contract into a reality.

shows.title: Bodhi Varma: Return of the Beggar Dragon
shows.description:
He came as a nobody… but sat on the Dragon Throne.
Now the whole kingdom wants to know - who REALLY is Varman? The truth awaits - Watch now!

shows.title: Bogus Phone Operators
shows.description: A gripping true-crime documentary uncovering the dark world of scam call centers. From fake tech support to emotional fraud, Bogus Phone Operators exposes the masterminds behind global phone scams—and the unsuspecting victims whose lives they ruin.

shows.title: Born Again
shows.description: Born Again

shows.title: Born for Revenge
shows.description: Watch this show now live on Kuku Tv!

shows.title: Born to Be a Legend
shows.description: When an ordinary delivery driver, Rajveer, saves a mysterious woman named Siya, he’s pulled into a supernatural mystery — her unborn child speaks to him, claiming to be an ancient immortal warrior reborn. As dark forces and powerful enemies close in, Rajveer and Siya must protect the miraculous baby destined to change the fate of the world. Born to Be a Legend is a gripping blend of myth, mystery, and emotion — where love, destiny, and divine power collide. Watch now!

shows.title: Born To Rise
shows.description: Jia, a hardworking Hindi-medium village girl, prepares for her engineering entrance to change her father Jeevan’s life. But her uncle Ravi, aunt Meena and cousin Sidhu humiliate her, steal her savings, and label her a cheater and immoral girl. The village sarpanch punishes her father with 30 lashes. Jia refuses to break and bets her fate on the exam result—ready to make them pay when truth explodes.

shows.title: Born to Rule
shows.description: Born to Rule

shows.title: Born to Smash
shows.description: A disgraced table tennis legend hiding as a janitor is forced to coach a collapsing sports club, where he transforms a bullied ball picker into a national-level weapon, while fighting to keep his own explosive past from being exposed.

shows.title: The CEO's Secret Bodyguard
shows.description: When fiery CEO Navya Kapoor fakes a relationship with the mysterious and charming Aarav Deshmukh to escape a forced engagement, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and bullets blaze. But what happens when her contract boyfriend turns out to be a deadly secret agent with a mission of his own? Watch Now!

shows.title: Boss Baby aur Tamasha
shows.description: Kavya, a hardworking single mother, never expected her past with the powerful CEO Meher Raichandani to resurface. But when her son Rohan’s truth comes to light, Meher is forced to confront secrets, family rivalries, and Alisha’s schemes. In a battle of love, power, and legacy, will Kavya protect her child or be trapped in Meher’s world? Watch Now!

shows.title: Daddy Danger
shows.description: Daddy Boss is a high-voltage-family drama where A waiter , saves a rich girl, , from the clutches of a wealthy man. He is actually a secret head of the syndicate , but he has hidden this identity from everyone – even his own son. How will he navigate his life while also fighting his enemies on his journey? Watch Now!

shows.description: Boss Gu's Intern Wife

shows.title: Boss Intern
shows.description: She joined as an intern, never expecting to be tied to the boss by marriage. Between corporate chaos and marital secrets, every day is a test of loyalty, ambition, and love. A gripping tale where office politics meet heart politics. Watch Now!

shows.title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
shows.description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

shows.title: Boss Mafia Took Me
shows.description: “A helpless girl is kidnapped by a ruthless mafia boss to settle a deadly score, pulling her into a world of danger, power, and forbidden desire. As hatred turns into obsession and secrets unfold, their lives spiral into a dark, intoxicating war between love and control.”

shows.title: Boss Revenge Squad
shows.description: When the system shatters lives, some cry — others swear to break it. Boss Revenge Squad follows four wronged people — a fallen businessman, a genius hacker, an ex-cop and a street-smart hustler — who band together to take down ruthless bosses who exploit and destroy their employees. Calculated plans, brutal payback and a corporate war where every secret becomes a weapon. This isn’t just revenge — it’s corporate warfare.

shows.description: .Boss wants to marry me

shows.title: Ugly Bani Paramsundari
shows.description: When your first day at college turns into a battlefield of bullies, betrayal, and blurred lines, how do you fight back? Braced-Up Girl is a fierce ride through the chaos of campus life, self-respect, and the search for identity. This isn’t just a teen drama—it’s Kanika’s war for dignity. Watch Now!

shows.title: Brahmrakshas
shows.description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

shows.title: Dil Ka Profit
shows.description: Once deeply in love, two souls were torn apart by the cruel hand of fate. Years later, destiny weaves its mysterious threads, bringing them face to face once more. As old emotions resurface and hearts begin to beat in rhythm again, the question lingers—will their love blossom anew, or will fate, once again, play its harsh game and pull them apart?

shows.title: Breaking Crime: Laal Drum
shows.description: Sushant Singh narrates a chilling crime story where a seemingly perfect family hides dangerous secrets, betrayal, and obsession. When a husband returns home after sensing something is terribly wrong, a horrifying mystery begins to unfold. A red drum sealed with cement, missing family members, hidden affairs, and shocking lies lead police into one of the most disturbing murder investigations imaginable. But who is the real monster behind it all?

shows.title: Breaking The Stalemate
shows.description: Fiction

shows.title: Breakup Se Bana Billionaire
shows.description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

shows.title: Brother Betrayal (Gujarati)
shows.description: Alok is an ordinary man, yet he sacrifices his entire life for his younger brother Rohan’s education. Did Rohan study well and succeed? Was Alok able to protect his home? To find out, watch "Brother Betrayal"  on Kuku TV.

shows.title: Brother Betrayal
shows.description: Alok Upadhyay, a noble elder brother, sacrifices everything to secure a bright future for his younger brother Rohan. But as Alok rises to power with the support of his devoted wife Anita and strong-willed daughter Aditi, Rohan, twisted by greed and fueled by his arrogant wife Diya, betrays the very family that gave him everything. A tale of sacrifice, ambition, and the tragic downfall of brotherhood.

shows.title: Bulletproof Ishq
shows.description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

shows.title: BUMPED INTO A BEAUTIFUL CEO
shows.description: A lighthearted romantic drama about an ordinary man whose life takes a wild turn after accidentally crossing paths with a stunning, high-powered CEO. What begins as chaos soon turns into unexpected chemistry, as pride, passion, and fate collide in the most unexpected way.

shows.title: Secret Tadka
shows.description: Raju, a curious son who suspects his father Mahesh’s famous parathas hide a terrifying secret. As Raju uncovers the dark truth behind the family’s thriving food business and Mahesh’s strange bond with Priya, the kitchen turns into a battleground of trust, fear, and survival.

shows.title: Burning the Family Tree
shows.description: A fearless bodyguard infiltrates a wealthy but abusive family by marrying into it, only to wage a hidden war against their toxic legacy. With courage, secrets, and unexpected bonds, she sets out to protect the innocent and tear the dynasty apart from within.

shows.title: Bye Bye Husband
shows.description: “When a loyal wife is betrayed and discarded by her arrogant husband, she rises from heartbreak to power—determined to teach him the value of love, respect, and regret. But revenge turns complicated when her strength makes him fall for her all over again.”

shows.title: Car, Pyaar Aur Dhoka
shows.description: A neglected billionaire’s perfect life shatters when his wife’s secret lover crashes his supercar into him, triggering a brutal confrontation where betrayal is revealed in the middle of the street.
