shows.description: Catch the Groom

shows.title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
shows.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

shows.title: CEO Ka Chatpata Pyaar
shows.description: A cold, ailing CEO finds warmth in the most unexpected place—her dumpling shop. As flavors spark feelings, business and romance get deliciously tangled. A heartwarming tale of love, healing, and second chances. Watch Now !

shows.title: CEO Ki Chhupi Shaadi
shows.description: When powerful CEO Shaurya Singh secretly marries the spirited Ananya, their hidden bond sparks a storm of love, betrayal, and boardroom battles—testing loyalty, ambition, and the true meaning of partnership.

shows.title: CEO Ki Ghar Wapasi
shows.description: Ceo goes to village and gets mistaken for a poor person.

shows.title: Pyaar ki Terms and Conditions
shows.description: When an arrogant business tycoon Tanishq Chaudhary and fiery hotel butler Vamika Sharma are forced into a shocking contract marriage, love and ego collide. What starts as a deal soon turns into a dangerous game of hearts, where every emotion comes with conditions.

shows.title: CEO's Magical Bodyguard
shows.description: Chirag Chauhan lives as an ordinary man, hiding the truth that he is the last disciple of the legendary yogi Neeldev. When he saves Nimisha, the fearless chairperson of the Nandini Group, destiny places him as her personal bodyguard. Between power struggles, betrayal, a forced contract marriage, and rising enemies, Chirag must protect Nimisha while keeping his divine identity secret until fate forces him to reveal his true strength.

shows.title: Deal with Billionaire
shows.description: “Deal with Billionaire” is a dramatic saga of love, betrayal, and destiny that follows Simran, a humble waitress who unknowingly belongs to a wealthy family. After years of struggle, heartbreak, and deceit, her life changes when she reunites with her four rich brothers and faces powerful enemies, toxic relationships, and a world of greed while fighting to reclaim her identity and self-respect

shows.title: Chairman No. 1
shows.description: A self-made chairman returns to honor his village, only to discover his own factory has become a living hell for the very people who raised him. Disguising himself as a worker, he uncovers corruption, exploitation, and betrayal at every level. As truth burns through lies, the hidden chairman rises to deliver justice—turning victims into warriors and a broken system into his battlefield.

shows.title: Chaiwala Dulhania Le Jayega
shows.description: A billionaire CEO hides behind the mask of a humble chaiwala to win the heart of the woman he has loved since his teenage years. When Shruti runs away from a forced marriage, fate throws her into Dharam’s arms—sparking a contract marriage built on lies, laughter, and unexpected love. As class clashes, family drama, and buried truths surface, Dharam must choose between protecting his secret and risking everything for honest love

shows.title: Chaiwala Hero
shows.description: Separated by a terrorist attack 20 years ago, a father and son reunite on opposite sides of a billion-dollar conspiracy. One is a tycoon in disguise; the other, a tea-seller with a weapon that could change the world.

shows.title: Chak De Champion
shows.description: Yash, a talented but poor cricketer, struggles against class bias, betrayal, and a cruel system that favors the rich. Framed, humiliated, and nearly destroyed by Hardy and his allies, he fights back with resilience and truth. As secrets unravel, Yash is revealed as the true heir of the Rawat family, reclaiming his identity, dignity, and place in cricket.

shows.title: Chandravansham
shows.description:
Chandravansham is story of Aryaveer, abandoned at birth, rises from a nameless shepherd to a legendary warrior. Betrayed by blood yet driven by truth, he fights to reclaim identity, family, and honor.
In the clash of power and destiny, he proves that true strength lies beyond lineage. Watch now.

shows.title: Chashme Badoor
shows.description: Watch Chashme Badoor only on kukutv!

shows.title: Chasing Gold
shows.description: Chasing Gold is an intense sports drama about courage, sacrifice, and national pride. Once disgraced kickboxing champion Arvind, haunted by a doping scandal, is forced back into the ring when his fearless daughter Saanvi takes on a dangerous challenge against Pakistan’s top fighters. As generations clash and blood is spilled for honor, their battle becomes more than a fight—it’s a war for respect, identity, and the soul of a nation.

shows.title: Chat Mangni Pat Vyah
shows.description: A fiery small-town girl, Bani, storms into a rich CEO Parth’s life after a hilarious misunderstanding leads to a forced marriage. While Parth hides his true identity, their fake relationship slowly turns real amid family drama, betrayal, power struggles, and corporate intrigue. As enemies plot against them, Bani proves her strength, wins respect, and ultimately stands as both Parth’s equal and the true powerhouse behind it all.

shows.title: Chaukanna 24x7
shows.description: Watch This Drama "Chaukanna 24x7" Only On Kuku TV!

shows.title: Chef's Secret Wife
shows.description: Ishika is a talented and ambitious chef who marries a man she has never met. Months later, she is selected for a cooking reality show, where she comes face to face with celebrity chef Abhay Rajput After eliminating her from the show, Abhay offers Ishika a job at his restaurant. Gradually, Ishika discovers that Abhay is not only her boss, but also her husband—setting the stage for a complex story of power, ego, trust, and growing passion.

shows.title: Ek Anokha Rishta
shows.description: Cold-hearted billionaire Vikram Mehra and struggling singer Sunita are forced into a sudden contract marriage under unexpected circumstances. As their worlds collide, one of wealth, secrets, and control, the other of dreams, resilience, and warmth this unlikely bond sparks real emotions. But when fake vows start feeling real, love becomes the most unpredictable twist of all.

shows.title: Chori Mein Mohabbat
shows.description:
This is the story of a fearless, street-smart thief Aishwarya, whose life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with Siddharth Raghuvanshi, the powerful heir of an underworld empire. What begins as a daring heist soon becomes a dangerous game of attraction, betrayal, and survival.
As Aishwarya’s sharp instincts clash with Siddharth’s authority, their chemistry turns electric — every glance charged with risk and desire. Between stolen money and stolen hearts, the line between love and crime starts to blur.
When a high-stakes robbery spirals out of control, both are forced to choose: trust their hearts or protect their secrets. In this world of deception and danger, one wrong move could cost them everything — even the love born from chaos.
At its core, Chori Mein Mohabbat is a passionate crime thriller — a story where romance ignites in the shadows of betrayal, and love itself becomes the ultimate heist.

shows.title: Chuppa Rustom Damad
shows.description: Ritesh Gupta, the powerful CEO of Star Industry, concealed his immense wealth and status when he fell in love. He married a woman whose family, unaware he was India's richest person, constantly belittled and mistreated him for what they saw as his lowly status.

shows.title: Chuppa Rustom
shows.description: A humble salesman, Tanay, secretly the heir to a massive business empire, hides his identity to find true love with Dia. Misjudged as poor, he faces insults from her greedy family while proving his worth through hard work. Dia betrays him for wealth, unaware of his real status. After rising as a powerful entrepreneur, Tanay exposes the truth, leading to regret, revenge, and justice.

shows.title: Chuppi
shows.description: Chuppi is a dark psychological thriller about a woman trapped in an abusive marriage with a powerful ACP. After escaping and starting a new life under a false identity, Aarohi finds hope and healing, until her past hunts her down. The series is a haunting exploration of silence, survival, and the courage to finally speak up. Watch now!

shows.title: Clocked in Power, His Secret Identity
shows.description: Clocked in Power

shows.title: CM ki Dulhan
shows.description: CM ki Dulhan is a political family drama set against the backdrop of dynastic Indian politics. The series explores how women, often treated as pawns in the game of power, can become players who change the very rules of the game. At its heart, the story is a love story born out of compulsion, evolving into a political partnership of equals. Through betrayal, corruption, and power struggles, Anandi and Arjun’s journey reflects themes of loyalty. Watch Now.

shows.title: Code War
shows.description: When a massive cyber attack cripples India’s defense, an unsung AI genius secretly prevents disaster - only to be betrayed by those he saved. Left broken and discarded, he rises from the ashes, reclaiming his brilliance to build an empire that rewrites the rules of power. This is a saga of revenge, vision, and redemption - where technology becomes both a weapon and salvation.

shows.title: Codename Pyaar
shows.description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

shows.title: Comeback of XXL CEO
shows.description: Sameer Lambani, an overweight CEO of an 800-crore company, lies in a hospital ICU reflecting on his life. Through narration, he reveals how people underestimated him despite his wealth and power. The story blends his vulnerable health condition with flashbacks of his corporate journey. It explores themes of perception, ambition, and the cost of success. Watch now.

shows.title: Commando Panther
shows.description: A decorated special forces commander, living incognito as a mechanic to escape his traumatic past, finds his secret life upended when he falls for a powerful CEO, forcing him to confront old enemies, a web of corporate conspiracies, and his own guilt to protect his new love and reclaim his destiny. Watch now.

shows.title: Contract Husband Of Boss Wife
shows.description: Kabir Malhotra is a poor construction worker who knows he is the grandson of a billionaire but refuses to accept that identity. Betrayed by his girlfriend and crushed by a ruthless tycoon, Kabir’s life collapses when his mother’s life is at risk. A shocking contract marriage with a powerful businesswoman forces him to face his legacy, turning a man who rejected wealth into a threat no empire can ignore.

shows.title: Contract Wala Pyaar
shows.description: Alia, desperate to save her mother, is forced into a 6-month contract marriage with the mysterious Karan Malhotra. What begins as a deal soon turns into a tangled journey of care, betrayal, hidden identities, and unexpected love. Will their bond survive the lies and conspiracies—or will this marriage remain just a contract? Watch Now!

shows.title: Coolie Ki Diamond Dulhaniya
shows.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Aryan, a humble porter, and Aarohi, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Aarohi chooses love over wealth and society, Aryan is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.

shows.title: Copper finch spring is deep and beautiful.
shows.description: A humble village girl enters the royal palace, unaware that her past is tied to a brutal secret that once shook the kingdom. As she faces rivalry, destiny, and hidden danger, her quiet strength becomes the spark that changes the royal world forever.

shows.title: Could this be my son?
shows.description: What if the child you rescue becomes the reason your world falls apart? This Could Be My Son is a chilling psychological drama where empathy, obsession, and hidden truths collide. Dive into a gripping tale of blurred boundaries and buried trauma. Watch Now!

shows.title: Countdown King
shows.description: Dhokha, gareebi aur majboori se shuru hui Anuj ki zindagi ek accident ke baad poori tarah palat gayi. Ab woh logon ki maut ka waqt hi nahi, balki antiques ki asli keemat , chhupi bimaariyan,  aur stocks ka future bhi dekh sakta tha. Ek delivery boy shehar ka kingmaker ban gaya. Jis biwi ne use thukraaya tha, use apni galti ka daam chukaana pada… aur jis shehar ne Anuj ko kam samjha tha, wahi uske rutbe ka gawaah bana. par wo ek baat bhul gaya ki har power ka ek khaufnaak daam hota hai.

shows.title: Crash Landed Into Love
shows.description: After a plane crash, billionaire heir Amar Luthra survives with amnesia and is saved by kind-hearted surgeon Dr. Rumi. While greedy nurse Nisha fakes Amar’s death to seize the Luthra empire, Amar lives as a nobody beside the woman who saved him—until love, truth, and a ruthless conspiracy collide, forcing him to reclaim his identity before Rumi loses everything.

shows.title: Cricket Samraat
shows.description: Cricket Samraat is an inspirational underdog sports drama set in Mumbai’s chawls, where a forgotten gully cricketer rises against power, privilege, and corruption. Forced to play dhol for survival, Viraj challenges an elite system to protect his chawl, his people, and their dignity. The series celebrates resilience, unity, friendship and the belief that true champions are forged through struggle, not privilege. Watch now!

shows.title: Cricketer Ki Love Story
shows.description: After a masked one-night encounter with India’s hottest cricket star, struggling physiotherapy student Shanaaya disappears, unknowingly leaving behind the ring her mother gave her. Humiliated and determined to find the mysterious girl who “priced” him, star cricketer Vicky Khurana launches a public hunt. When fate makes Shanaaya his personal physio, a dangerous game of secrets, class conflict, and rising attraction begins.

shows.title: Crorepati Cakewala
shows.description: Karan, a poor scrap-collector boy, struggles to save his cancer-stricken mother, unaware he’s the lost heir of the powerful Rathore family. Twenty years later, Rama Rathore has built an empire but still searches for her vanished son. Fate brings them face-to-face, mother and son, unaware of their blood bond, just as betrayal, greed, and revenge close in. The moment truth surfaces, everything they’ve built may burn, because the royal prince is about to return. Watch Now!

shows.title: Crorepati Ki Jhaadu
shows.description: CROREPATI KA JHADU is a gripping drama about hidden power, betrayal, and redemption. Raghav, a humble janitor in an NGO, secretly carries the past of being the director of one of the world’s biggest finance companies. As conspiracies, family tensions, and corporate rivalries close in, his quiet life unravels—forcing him to reveal his true identity and rise against those who tried to bury him.

shows.title: Crown and Clown
shows.description: When a grief-stricken prince and his street-smart lookalike accidentally swap lives, their playful escape spirals into a deadly conspiracy — forcing the two unlikely brothers-in-spirit to outwit murderous royals, reclaim a stolen throne, and redefine what it truly means to wear the crown… or survive without one.

shows.title: Crown Of Justice
shows.description: A powerful emperor, traveling in disguise, reunites with his long-lost mother in famine-stricken Nanzhou—only to uncover a horrifying truth. As corrupt officials exploit starving citizens, he witnesses injustice, cruelty, and death firsthand. Torn between identity and duty, he must rise to deliver justice before the system destroys what little humanity remains

shows.title: Cruise Saga
shows.description: Determined to investigate poor reviews of his family's luxury cruise line, billionaire CEO Aditya Rathod goes undercover as a lowly steward, only to endure relentless abuse from classist employees and a heartbreaking betrayal by his long-term girlfriend—ultimately finding true love and justice with a spirited supervisor who valued his character long before she knew his net worth.

shows.title: Bitcoin Billionaire
shows.description: Yash Narain, a failed husband and broken man, gets a second chance at life when he wakes up ten years in the past. With his mother Alka alive, his ex-wife Shree slipping away, and his treacherous friend Kumar plotting against him, Yash risks everything in the volatile world of Bitcoin to rise as India’s ‘Crypto King.’ But every fortune comes at a deadly cost. Watch Now!

shows.title: Cursed By Love
shows.description: Vaishnavi, a devoted woman, faces heartbreak when her husband betrays and abandons her. But beneath her sorrow lies a shocking truth she is a wealthy heir and a genius ready to reclaim her power. As she rises from humiliation, fate brings her to Vikranth Desai, a commanding CEO who treats her with unmatched devotion. Unlike her cruel past, he showers her with love and respect, standing by her side as she exposes enemies and seeks justice.

shows.title: Billionaire Sasur ka Badla
shows.description: Ruhi traps a rich heir, pretending to be innocent while secretly cheating on him. When she humiliates an old man at a car showroom—beating him, insulting him, and burning his wife’s last photograph—she doesn’t realize he is Rajat Singhania, the billionaire founder and her fiancé’s father. Now the insulted tycoon plans a brutal revenge, determined to expose her truth and destroy her in front of the entire city.

shows.title: Dad, Let Me Clean The House
shows.description: When a young daughter insists on cleaning the family home, she uncovers a hidden past her father tried to bury forever. A simple chore becomes a turning point that changes their relationship and their lives forever.

shows.title: Dad, Love Me Again
shows.description: A palace maid with a mysterious past rises through the imperial court, navigating love, betrayal, and political intrigue. As secrets unfold, she must choose between loyalty to the empire and her own survival.

shows.title: Delivery Wala Billionaire
shows.description: Ek simple delivery boy jise sab log ignore karte hain... asal mein duniya ke top 5 richest logon mein se ek nikalta hai. Uska beta hai ek young billionaire CEO, aur khud bana hua hai gareeb sirf apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye. Jab duniya uske self-respect pe thookti hai, toh ek ek karke uska asli power reveal hota hai – stocks, politics, revenge, aur love ke is game mein sabke mooh band ho jaate hain.

shows.title: Daddy Cool, Beta Fool
shows.description: A powerful billionaire returns after a decade in hiding, disguised as a poor cab driver, to test his son’s loyalty and uncover the betrayal poisoning his family. As insults, greed, and manipulation push him to the edge, Randhir Ahuja prepares a shocking reveal that will destroy illusions, expose true faces, and change their lives forever.

shows.title: Daddy Ke Dost Ki Dulhan
shows.description: Naina ka dil tootne ki raat usse seedha Samar Bajaj ki zindagi me le aayi. Samar, jo usse 13 saal bada aur usse kahin zyada samajhdaar tha. Nashe me hui ek galti ne unhe shaadi ke bandhan me baandh diya. Naina ko laga yeh rishta bas majboori hai… par Samar to kabse chhup-chhup kar usse chahta tha. Use sirf ek cheez ka intezaar tha — us pal ka, jab Naina usse sach-much dil se chahegi

shows.title: Dahaad
shows.description: Dahaad is a story of a rising wrestler, whose dream shatters when betrayal, false doping charges, and sacrifice tear lovers apart. Eight years later, truth resurfaces through their daughter, forcing fate to reunite them. Dahaad is a powerful saga of love, sacrifice, redemption, and justice.Watch now.

shows.title: Damaad 420
shows.description: In Bihar’s lawless heartland, small-time genius conman Keshav Kumar (KK) accidentally ignites a gang war after stealing an entire iron bridge to save a friend. Pulled into a bloody power struggle between liquor mafia don Chuna Chaudhary and ruthless MLA Tinku Yadav, KK cons, schemes, marries into crime, and outsmarts killers—until survival demands he stop running scams and claim the throne himself.

shows.title: Damaad No. 1
shows.description: Yash returns from London to his wife Mehak, only to be mocked as a "gold-digger" by her elite family who favor the wealthy Neel. While they plot to force a divorce, Yash hides his true identity as the powerful CEO of Blackthorn. Facing constant insults and even a police setup, Yash eventually peels back the layers of deception surrounding Neel and his family, proving that true worth isn't always found in a dapper suit. Watch now.

shows.title: Super Damaad
shows.description: “A humble son-in-law humiliated and thrown out by his greedy in-laws returns years later as a powerful, self-made man. When secrets explode and tables turn, the family that once insulted him is forced to face the damaad they never valued.”

shows.title: Dangerous Comeback
shows.description: A brutal family throws Aditya out, crushing his dreams and torturing his mother. Years later, Aditya rises from nothing to become a powerful CEO. He returns to reclaim his family’s dignity and confront his past. Watch now.

shows.title: Dangerous Dad
shows.description: A cleaner, Aaryan, saves a rich girl, Avni, from the clutches of a wealthy man. Aaryan is actually a secret head of the syndicate and is called Ghost, but he has hidden this identity from everyone – even his own son. How will he navigate his life while also fighting his enemies on his journey? Watch now!

shows.title: Dangerous Divorce
shows.description: "Wrong Diagnosis, Right Divorce" is a devoted husband is ready to die for love—only to discover love was the lie. Betrayal, greed, and ambition strip him of marriage, dignity, and everything he built. But when truth, talent, and karma collide, justice arrives sharper than revenge. Watch now.

shows.title: Daring Bodyguard
shows.description: Shaurya, ek highly trained fighter, Aarohi Sehgal ko protect karne ke liye ek normal security guard bankar uski zindagi mein aata hai. Aarohi ne “Sunspire” naam ki ek aisi dawa invent ki hai jo cancer ka ilaaj ban sakti hai. Is discovery ke peeche powerful Nirvaan Vardhaan pada hai. Mission ke dauraan Shaurya ko ek khaufnaak sach pata chalta hai—Nirvaan ke baap Armaan Vardhaan ne uski family ko barbaad kiya tha. Ab yeh sirf protection ka mission nahi, balki Shaurya ke liye ek personal war hai.

shows.title: Revenge Wali Shaadi
shows.description: “Dark Secrets” is an intense romantic thriller that follows Ananya, a young doctor trapped in a web of deceit, betrayal, and hidden agendas after being falsely accused of a scandal. When her path crosses with Kabir Deewan, a man awakening from a coma with a mysterious past, their fates intertwine in a dangerous game of love, revenge, and shocking family secrets

shows.title: Daulat ki Taaqat
shows.description: A misunderstanding turns violent when a man is mistaken for a stalker, only to reveal he’s a grieving father searching for his long-lost daughter, Naina. Years later, now a powerful yet secretive tycoon, he continues his search while battling betrayal, crime, and deception. As destinies collide, a lost daughter rises unknowingly close to him, facing love, betrayal, and identity. Watch now.

shows.title: Dead Man Returns
shows.description: A woman who believes her husband died in a tragic accident is forced to rebuild her life—only for him to return years later as a powerful, vengeful man who thinks she betrayed him, igniting a battle of love, lies, and a hidden truth that could change everything.

shows.title: Deadly Temptation
shows.description: Deadly Temptation

shows.title: Dear CEO, Goodbye
shows.description: A powerful CEO and his devoted secretary are bound by a secret contract and forbidden love, even as his fiancée enters the picture. Their passion, betrayal, and past secrets ignite a battle between love, loyalty, and ambition.

shows.title: Death Notification
shows.description: Death Notification is a dark, gripping thriller about fate, survival, and a cursed gift. Abdul, a poor ragpicker, discovers he can see the exact time and cause of people’s deaths as glowing notifications on their foreheads. Haunted by tragedy yet determined to save lives, he walks a dangerous path—where every choice to change destiny comes with an unimaginable price.

shows.title: Death Reloaded
shows.description: A group of travelers becomes trapped inside an abandoned jungle hotel where terrifying events begin after sunset. While others mock his warnings, Rahul believes deadly man-eating ants are hiding in the darkness. As betrayals, fear, and panic spread through the group, the creatures close in, turning the night into a brutal fight for survival. In the end, the real danger may not just be outside, but within the group itself.

shows.title: Deewana
shows.description:
What happens when the man who saves lives… becomes a killer to protect them? 
Ranveer Singh, a brilliant but hot-blooded surgeon, is torn between love, rage, and justice. From avenging his sister’s dignity to protecting a father who never gave him love, he battles enemies hidden within his own bloodline. Deewana is the story of a son’s obsession, a lover’s heartbreak, and a warrior’s vow to carve out justice, even if it costs him his life. Watch Now!

shows.title: Delivery Boy Vs Billionaires
shows.description: In a glittering high-rise society where status is everything, a brutal misunderstanding spirals into a nightmare. When Bollywood superstar Kritika Kapoor collapses alone in her apartment due to a life-threatening illness, her fiancé—Arjun Sabarwal, a secretive billionaire and CEO of a fast-growing delivery empire—rushes to save her, disguised as a delivery boy.

shows.title: Delivery Girl Ka Secret Empire
shows.description: What if every doorstep delivery carried a bigger story? Not Just a Delivery Girl reveals the struggles, hopes, and resilience of a woman redefining her life. Watch Now !

shows.title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
shows.description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

shows.title: Desh ki Beti
shows.description:
In a world where love and betrayal walk hand in hand, one girl’s journey transforms her from innocence to unstoppable power.
Her past is filled with pain, her present with determination, and her future with destiny.
She rises against all odds not just to survive, but to conquer.
A story of sacrifice, resilience, and revenge… where every secret has a price, and every truth changes everything.

shows.title: Deshbhakt Pandit
shows.description: What happens when a nation’s future rests in the hands of one man who refuses to bow down? Deshbhakt Pandit takes you on a thrilling journey of resilience, sacrifice, and unshakable love for the country. Watch Now !

shows.title: Destiny On Demand
shows.description: A fascinating documentary that explores how technology, data, and algorithms are reshaping human fate. From streaming platforms that predict our desires to AI systems that influence our choices, Destiny on Demand dives into a future where convenience meets control—and questions who’s really in charge of our destiny.

shows.title: Devil Se Shaadi
shows.description: A fearless woman crosses paths with a ruthless yet charming mafia boss, igniting a dangerous game of power and desire. As enemies close in, their fiery bond blurs the line between love and destruction.

shows.title: Billionaire's Revenge
shows.description: Dhadkan

shows.title: When a Billionaire Met a Mafia Family On a Train
shows.description: On a speeding train, a wounded young woman is brutally humiliated, branded a gold-digger, and nearly killed by a ruthless billionaire family—until a shocking truth explodes: the “helpless” girl they tortured is actually the only daughter of the powerful tycoon they’re desperate to marry into.

shows.title: Dhokha, Shaadi aur Hungama
shows.description: “A kind-hearted girl on her way to her brother’s wedding gets trapped in a nightmarish flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son, leading to chaos that unravels shocking secrets of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. When love, lies, and family honor collide, a storm of revenge and revelation erupts midair and beyond.”

shows.title: Dhokhebaaz Haseena
shows.description: After surviving a life-altering betrayal, Anant travels back three years to rewrite his history. He thwarts a murder plot orchestrated by his wife, Sonia, and his driver, Mayank, by turning their own scheme against them. Anant systematically strips Sonia of her status and wealth while exposing the greed of her sisters. The story ends with Anant finding true love with Kritika, while his betrayers face total ruin, madness, and imprisonment.

shows.title: Dhurandhar Arjun
shows.description: After faking his disappearance from the Chandra Vansh army, the legendary archer Arjun lives in disguise as a humble servant to fulfill his dying guru’s last wish , protecting his guru’s daughter and granddaughter. But when greed, betrayal, and deadly warriors threaten to destroy the Gurukul, Arjun must decide whether to remain hidden… or rise again as the unstoppable Dhurandhar.

shows.title: Dhurandhar: Child King Returns
shows.description: Hazaar saal purana yuvraj… ek modern 6 saal ke bachche ke sharir mein jaagta hai. Keshav Rajhans ko nahi pata yeh kismat ka khel hai ya kisi ki sazish. Par Rajhans parivaar ki andheri siyasat mein, uska tezz dimag sabko hila deta hai. Ab dekhna yeh hai - kya ek bachcha puri kismat palat sakta hai?

shows.title: God Of Cricket
shows.description: The story revolves around Raghu, a poor ground staff worker who secretly possesses an extraordinary and almost supernatural bowling ability — the legendary “fireball”, capable of reaching impossible speeds and destroying stumps like a weapon. Despite being the most gifted player, Raghu hides his talent due to a painful past tied to cricket, loss, and personal tragedy.

shows.title: Dhoorandhar Nishaanebaz
shows.description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.

shows.title: Dhurandhar Of Kashmir
shows.description: Feared underworld kingpin Nic’s life takes a sharp turn when he meets Kusha, a sheltered girl fleeing her controlling mother. As danger, betrayal, and a police manhunt close in, their unexpected love becomes his path to redemption. But when Nic’s past resurfaces and a traitor destroys his empire, he must choose between vengeance, family, and the woman who awakens his humanity.

shows.title: Dhurandhar Qaidi
shows.description: Laksh Malhotra, an undercover army hero, returns home to find his father’s legacy ruined by corruption. To uncover the truth, he deliberately gets arrested and enters Dharamveer Correctional Jail as Qaidi Number 17. Inside, he faces torture, betrayal, and deadly guards while secretly collecting proof. With help from allies, he exposes the corrupt system and restores justice. Watch now.

shows.title: Revenge of a Best Friend
shows.description: Revenge of a Best friend is a gripping cyber-thriller about a respected senior citizen who becomes the victim of a chilling digital scam involving deepfake videos, blackmail, and psychological imprisonment. As his life collapses in silence, his grandson uncovers a dark web of betrayal, exposing how technology can be used to destroy dignity, trust, and lives from within.

shows.title: Dil Ka Encounter
shows.description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

shows.title: Dil ki Deal
shows.description:
Priya Sharma’s life shatters when she learns she can never become a mother after three months and catches her boyfriend cheating on her with her best friend. Humiliated, she impulsively vows to marry within a week and become pregnant within three months.

Meanwhile, businessman Nitin Malhotra is under pressure to marry and produce an heir or lose his family empire. To solve their problems, Nitin proposes a three-month contract marriage to Priya

shows.title: Dil Sambhal ja Zara
shows.description: The Mafia’s Surprise Heirs is a gripping story about betrayal, secrets, and unexpected family ties. When a powerful mafia leader’s hidden past resurfaces, two unsuspecting heirs are thrown into a dangerous world of crime, revenge, and forbidden love—where every choice could cost them their lives or the empire they never meant to inherit.

shows.title: Beghar Billionaire
shows.description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

shows.title: DIL VS DUTY
shows.description:
Garima Kaul’s impulsive marriage to a stranger turns her world upside down when she realizes her husband Neeraj is actually Aryan Scindia — her cold, powerful boss.
"The Second First Marriage" follows Garima and Aryan’s tangled journey of secrets, love, and second chances.

shows.title: Divine Husband
shows.description: Once a legendary sage seeking immortality, Anirudh is forced to reincarnate as Rahul, a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In the human world, he discovers he has a mute wife, Kajal. As his dormant powers awaken, Rahul chooses a new path: to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it costs him his godhood.

shows.title: Doctor's Divorce
shows.description: Dr. Niraj Chandra and Dr. Sanya Chandra, once deeply in love, now stand at the crossroads of separation. As their children, Ayaan and Ahana, struggle to keep the family together, love, respect, and old wounds collide in an emotional journey of what it truly means to be a family.

shows.title: Divorced Single Mother (Haryanvi)
shows.description: Divorced Single Mother (Haryanvi)

shows.title: Divorcee Ka Swayamvar
shows.description: "Divorced and Desired" is a fiery tale of betrayal, ambition, and reinvention. When Ishita is dumped for power and prestige, she doesn’t just bounce back—she builds an empire and makes her ex beg for mercy. This drama-packed audio series is your front-row seat to revenge, romance, and ruthless success. Watch Now!

shows.title: Doctor Sahab & Cutie
shows.description: Doctor Sahab Aur Cutie is a lighthearted romantic drama about fate, healing, and unexpected love. Dr. Arjun, a disciplined and aloof surgeon, crosses paths with bubbly and carefree Kavya, whose charm turns his orderly life upside down. As their worlds collide in hospitals, family drama, and heartfelt moments, their bond grows into a love story filled with laughter, warmth, and second chances.

shows.title: Doctor Vs Billionaires
shows.description: In a world of wealth, ego, and arrogance, little Aarya’s innocent prank spirals into a fight between life and death. While her heartbeat slips away in the hospital, the only doctor who can save her is trapped on the road, blackmailed, humiliated by a ruthless couple blinded by pride. As every second counts, shocking truths unfold, the child fighting for life may be their own daughter. Will redemption come in time… or will their cruelty cost them the one thing they can never replace? Watch Now!

shows.title: Dog Series Mom
shows.description: Watch "Dog Series Mom" only on kuku TV!

shows.title: Don Dolly Aur Dulhaniya
shows.description: The show follows Ishaan, a legendary "Underground Badshah" living in secrecy, who first abandons a toxic marriage with the ungrateful Gupta family after being humiliated. While evading secret agencies, he crosses paths with Vamika, a bold woman fleeing a forced marriage to the sleazy villain Gulshan Talwar. To protect her, Ishaan disguises himself as a lowly band player, eventually revealing his massive wealth and power to dismantle the corrupt Talwar and Kohli families.

shows.title: Don In Uniform
shows.description: Yash, ek underworld don, school ke ladke Rahul ko bachate hue maara gaya, aur uski aatma Rahul ke andar bas gayi. Kamzor aur bechaara Rahul, jise sab kam aankte the, ab Yash ki taakat aur swag ke saath badalne laga. Yash ne Rahul ko sambhalne aur uska graduation ka sapna poora karne ka faisla kiya. School mein Rahul hero ban gaya, ladkiyan uske charm ki deewani ho gayi. Lekin padhai aur beeta hua past uske liye badi chunauti ban gaye. Kahi Yash Rahul ko apni tarah criminal to nahi bana dega?

shows.title: Don't Mess with my Handsome Bodyguard
shows.description: Spoiled rich girl Suhani thinks she’s got the perfect groom, until her sassy, middle-class father Tough Daddy pulls the plug on her wedding just days before the big day. What follows is a hilarious war of egos, culture clashes, and unexpected emotions as Suhani and her stubborn dad clash over love, freedom, and family honor. In this chaotic rollercoaster, cancelling the wedding might just be the best thing that ever happened.

shows.title: Don't Treat Innocence as a Joke
shows.description: It is a sports drama with supernatural element. A little boy from the family of chess experts is now going to lead their prodigy. Kid plays chess better than any experienced player. Everyone think he is a natural but in reality his body is possessed by a world chess champion's soul who died while playing the game.

shows.title: Double Sided Maniac
shows.description: Watch "Double Sided Maniac" Only On KUKU TV!

shows.title: Shaadi On Fire
shows.description: A fiery twin impersonates her shy sister to confront a ruthless billionaire, but ends up falling for his equally powerful twin. Between mistaken identities, passion, and power games, love turns into the most dangerous deal of all.

shows.title: Double Trouble
shows.description: Shanaya walked away from Dhruv, the man who truly loved her, and chose an abusive husband hiding another marriage. What she thought was a winning choice soon turned into regret, while the man she abandoned rose to become a billionaire, finding love and happiness again. One Last Chance is a gripping story of betrayal, regret, and the price of choices.

shows.title: Dreams, Tea Aur Hum
shows.description: Rajneesh and Ruksaar are working individuals with a conflicting point of view towards life. Will their contrasting beliefs still manage to bring them together at the tea stall they frequent?

shows.title: DRISHYAM

shows.description: drama

shows.title: Dulhan Se Darling
shows.description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

shows.title: Dulhaniya In Paradise
shows.description: A bride runs away with a billionaire to an Island.

shows.title: DUMB HEIRESS
shows.description: A dramatic romantic-comedy about a misunderstood heiress who hides her sharp mind behind a simple, naive façade. While the world mocks her as “dumb,” she quietly plots revenge against those who betrayed her—proving that intelligence needs no announcement.

shows.title: Dil Wala Divorce
shows.description: Dil Wala Divorce follows Prapti, a woman betrayed by her own family and fiancé, who finds unexpected love and strength in Taksh, a mysterious businessman. What begins as revenge and heartbreak soon turns into a passionate, twisted romance.

shows.title: Duty Wala Daddy
shows.description: drama

shows.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
shows.description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti , a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

shows.title: Kismat Ka Khel
shows.description: “Kismat Ka Khel” is a family thriller about Angad, a kind-hearted young man raised in poverty, unaware that he is the lost heir of a billionaire family and grandson of a powerful RAW Chief. When his parents reunite with him after 20 years, they hide their true identities to protect him from dangerous enemies. Amid love, betrayal, class conflict, and hidden conspiracies, Angad uncovers his past and joins his family in a battle against ISI agents threatening their lives and the nation. Watch now!

shows.title: Married to The Sweetmaker for Ten Percent
shows.description: With just hours left before sunset to save her company, a fiercely independent CEO impulsively enters a contract marriage with an eccentric Chandni Chowk halwai she believes is ordinary. But as enemies close in and a mysterious poison threatens her life, she discovers her sweet-maker husband is actually a billionaire hiding in plain sight—the only man who can heal her, protect her, and fight beside her in a brutal battle for her empire.

shows.title: Shoorveer Ka Aagaman
shows.description: After living in hiding for 12 years as a humble laborer to protect his daughter, Surya, the legendary legendary "Shoorveer" of Veeram Palace, is forced back into action when corrupt elites brutally bully and kidnap her. He dismantles a powerful criminal conspiracy involving four elite families and the villainous "Master" from his past, ultimately reclaiming his mythical status to deliver absolute justice.

shows.title: Ek Anjana Ek Anjani
shows.description: Bunty Weds Babli is a romantic comedy set in Allahabad where two strangers, Ritika and Raghav, are unknowingly married through their grandparents’ old love story. A year later, they meet at work as boss and assistant, fall in love without realizing they are husband and wife, and end up unknowingly filing for divorce from each other.

shows.title: Ek Aur Anjaani Shaadi
shows.description: “Ek Aur Anjaani Shaadi" is a light-hearted romantic drama series about Arjun and Suhani, two strangers forced to pose as a married couple to achieve their professional goals. What begins as a fake arrangement soon spirals into comic situations, emotional clashes, and unexpected chemistry. As they juggle family pressures, nosy landlords, jealous rivals, and high-stakes business deals, their pretend marriage slowly transforms into a journey of real love, destiny, and happy chaos. Watch now!

shows.title: Ek Anjana Rishta
shows.description: Seven years after Diwali destroyed his life, billionaire Samrat Singh lives in guilt, believing his wife Shreya and their unborn child died in a tragic accident caused by his powerful father’s cruelty. Unknown to him, Shreya survived—left paralysed, traumatised, and living on the streets with her young daughter Jiya, who grows up scavenging bottles to keep her mother alive. Fate cruelly reunites them when Jiya steals Samrat’s ring to fund Shreya’s life-saving surgery, leading to humiliation, conflict, and heartbreak before the truth finally surfaces: Jiya is Samrat’s daughter, and Shreya is alive. As love, guilt, and redemption collide amid social cruelty and class divides, Aakhri Diya becomes a story of lost love, a child’s hope, and a broken family finding its way back to light.

shows.title: Ek Baap Sab Pe Bhaari
shows.description: A father branded as a wife killer returns after 10 years in jail… only to find his daughter trapped in abuse, hatred, and painful lies about his past. But Vikram isn’t just an ordinary man, he’s a feared legend ready to destroy anyone who hurts his child. As shocking secrets unfold, can a broken father win back his daughter’s trust before it’s too late?

shows.title: Ek CEO Do Dulhan
shows.description: When fearless and charismatic Aisha Verma becomes the nation’s youngest president, her marriage to devoted yet conflicted Arjun is tested by political intrigue, personal sacrifices, and the cost of power.

shows.title: Ek Janam Aur
shows.description: Ek Janam aur is an emotional tale of love, betrayal, and second chances. When Esha Chaudhary is betrayed by her closest ones and dies tragically, fate grants her a second life. With memories of her painful past intact, she resolves not to repeat old mistakes - this time, she will live for herself, chase her dreams, and choose freedom over toxic love. As her journey unfolds, she must navigate between destiny, ambition, and the haunting pull of her past relationships.

shows.title: Ek Khiladi Chaar Haseena
shows.description: After a mysterious old man gifts a humiliated delivery rider a device that grants 100X cashback on every rupee spent on a woman, he must systematically transform his life and "max out" the affection of four unique women to reclaim his power and become a king.

shows.title: Ek Mehenga Divorce
shows.description: A brilliant young doctor’s perfect life hides a haunting past — a broken childhood, a father destroyed by a ruthless marriage, and a mother whose greed turns love into tragedy. Ek Mehenga Divorce is an emotional rollercoaster tracing how one costly divorce shatters generations, leaving behind scars deeper than any wound.

shows.title: Love By Chance
shows.description: When 19-year-old Isha discovers she is mysteriously pregnant, her own family abandons her. A chance encounter with billionaire Shikhar Ahuja changes her fate, but living under his roof draws her into scandal, betrayal, and danger — until his son Dhruv becomes the unexpected protector of her unborn children… and her heart.

shows.title: Miles Between Us
shows.description: When a dying billionaire heir is saved by an unknown woman in the dark, fate binds them forever  without faces, names, or promises.

shows.title: Temporary Husband
shows.description:
**Ek Shaadi Aisi Bhi** is a high-voltage romantic drama where a powerful businesswoman and a self-made, principled man enter into a fake marriage.
Caught between love, ego, class divide, and revenge, their values and loyalties are put to the test.
What begins as a contract marriage slowly transforms into a story of real love and justice.

shows.title: Rum Ne Bana di Jodi
shows.description: Fiercely independent Priya and arrogant businessman Kabir Malhotra enter into a marriage of convenience bound by fate, not love. But as their hearts clash and hidden emotions rise, destiny plays its own game. In a world of contract vows, secret pasts, and family pressures, will their accidental marriage turn into a forever bond? Watch Now!

shows.title: Ek Tarfa Pyaar
shows.description: Talented jewellery artist Vivaan secretly loves his boss Myra and spends years helping build her dream company. But when her former lover Neil returns with an AI-powered design machine, Vivaan is humiliated, replaced, and falsely accused of sabotage. Heartbroken, he leaves and transforms himself into a powerful businessman. As Myra uncovers the truth about his sacrifices and loyalty, she realizes too late that the man she ignored may be lost forever.

shows.title: Emperor Yan
shows.description: It follows the fearless and clever maid Wei Yingluo as she enters the Forbidden City to uncover her sister’s murder and seek justice. Amidst palace intrigue, betrayals, and love, she rises through the ranks to become a powerful consort.

shows.title: Engineer vs Billionaires
shows.description: When a massive storm traps a ruthless billionaire and a humble engineer in a race against time, greed and conscience collide. As disaster looms over the Himalayan valley, one man’s arrogance meets another’s courage. From boardrooms to broken dams, Engineer vs Billionaires is a high-octane survival drama where nature takes revenge, power is tested, and redemption comes at the cost of pride.

shows.title: Eternal Love
shows.description: Wealthy businessman Vikram escapes his daughter’s matchmaking by lying he’s married. Avni, also pretending for family pressure, crosses paths with him while seeking a fake marriage certificate. They agree to a no-strings union, unaware fate has other plans. After an accident, Avni reenters Vikram’s life as his office cleaner. Forced to pose as his wife, love grows amid secrets and chaos. When they move to divorce, they discover they had been truly married all along.

shows.title: Eternal Yogi
shows.description: “Eternal Yogi” follows Gautam, an immortal yogi,  reunites with his lost love "Sunaina" , after 1200 years. Who Now reincarnated as Dr. Janvi Kapoor. Amid divine forces and demonic threats, he battles Kaalroop to protect both love and humanity. The saga ends with evil’s destruction and the lovers’ eternal union beyond time. Watch now.

shows.title: EVERY HOLIDAY I MISS MY WIFE
shows.description: EVERY HOLIDAY I MISS MY WIFE is story of a widowed man spends every holiday alone, haunted by memories of his late wife. Each festive season brings both joy and unbearable longing. But one unexpected encounter might change how he sees love and loss forever.

shows.title: Evil Phoenix Ridge
shows.description: Evil Phoenix Ridge

shows.title: Ex Ka Badla
shows.description: Once a humble house help in the Malhotra mansion, Anaya’s world shattered when arrogant heir Daksh Malhotra broke her trust and dignity. Years later, she returns transformed into a confident, powerful woman to infiltrate his world, unmask his secrets, and make him pay for every wound he left behind. Watch Now!

shows.title: Ex's on Double Date
shows.description: When Megha unexpectedly runs into her ex, Raghav, on a double date with Bhavna and Kabir, buried emotions, jealous sparks, and old wounds collide turning one night into a dangerous game of love, betrayal, and unfinished business. Watch Now!

shows.title: Fake Ashiqui
shows.description: A once-wealthy heir, Shivin, abandons his empire to prove his love, living as a humble delivery boy. But when his wife Kiara prioritizes status, wealth, and another man over their relationship even in moments of life and death, his world shatters. Betrayed, humiliated, and broken, Shivin rises from rock bottom to reclaim his identity, power, and self-respect, setting the stage for love, revenge, and redemption.

shows.title: Fake Boyfriend Exposed
shows.description: “After a painful separation, two former lovers are forced back into each other’s lives, reopening wounds they thought had healed. As hidden truths and unresolved feelings rise to the surface, they must decide whether fate is giving them a second chance—or one last heartbreak.”

shows.title: Fake Doctor
shows.description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

shows.title: Fake Girlfriend
shows.description: Fake Girlfriend is a powerful drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Anika Malhotra, secretly the billionaire owner of Redrock, returns to India after ten years to reunite with her old love Ritwik, only to find him arrogant and greedy. When the truth of her identity shatters those who once humiliated her, Anika chooses self-respect, stands by true love, and redefines power on her own terms.

shows.title: Fake husband, Nikla CEO
shows.description: Isha, a kind and simple girl, is betrayed by her jealous step-sister Naina, who drugs her and tries to ruin her reputation. When her life falls apart, a simple security guard named Aadi stands by her side and marries her. What Isha doesn’t know is that Aadi is actually Aditya Shekhawat, a powerful billionaire hiding his identity. As secrets come out and enemies confess, love and truth give Isha the respect and happiness she deserves

shows.title: Fake Marriage
shows.description: When struggling IIT student Vikram Raghuvanshi accepts a mysterious offer from powerful businessman Rajveer Mehra, his life takes an unexpected turn. Bound by a deal to marry Rajveer’s arrogant daughter Devanshi, Vikram is thrown into a world of power, deceit, and heartbreak. What begins as a contract soon spirals into a storm of betrayal, sacrifice, and redemption ending with one final, unforgettable goodbye.

shows.title: Fake Shaadi
shows.description: A fiery journalist and a charming CEO accidentally get married to impress his grandmother, but their fake marriage spirals into real emotions, family feuds, and shocking past secrets. Love, lies, and revenge intertwine as their impulsive bond turns into an unexpected destiny.

shows.title: Fake Waris
shows.description:
Aroshi, heir to Mittal Sweets and Namkeen, learns that her husband Shlok and best friend Riddhi swapped her newborn to seize her empire. She secretly reverses the switch and raises both boys, waiting 18 years for revenge.

On their 18th birthday, as Shlok and Riddhi plot to take over and kill her, Aroshi’s plan unfolds—revealing shocking truths, uniting her sons, and, with Raghu (the powerful RK Shekhawat), exposing the betrayal and reclaiming her legacy.

shows.title: Fakes Rich To Marry Billionaire
shows.description: “A poor girl pretends to be wealthy to marry a billionaire, but her lies pull her into a dangerous web of love, rivalry, and betrayal. As truth threatens to shatter her world, she must choose between survival, dignity, and true love.”

shows.title: Fakir Badshah
shows.description: When Princess Ananya Suryavanshi is betrayed and reborn, destiny gives her a second chance — to rewrite her fate and uncover the truth about the mysterious “beggar” she marries, Prithvi, who hides a royal secret. As greed, power, and vengeance drive her sister Radhika to ruin, Ananya rises from ashes — from Fakir’s wife to Sultan’s queen.

shows.title: False Promise
shows.description: A young woman who was raised by a rich family and has dreams of marrying one of the two heirs of the family. But those two brothers despise her as they believe she’s ill-mannered towards their close friend. The close friend is in fact the woman who is after the money of the two brothers and wants to replace the young woman by framing her for misdeeds.

shows.title: Family ki Taqdeer
shows.description: man separated from his family due to a tragic accident, finds himself working as a sweeper in the same company that he built years ago - only to be humiliated by his own son who has no idea who he is. While dealing with all the humiliation, he saves his own son from a major business conspiracy and reclaims his family as well as his position.

shows.title: The Wife's Secret
shows.description: A legendary secret agent, living a deep-cover life as a mocked and "disappointing" insurance agent, is forced to abandon his status-obsessed family when a catastrophic bio-threat emerges, leaving them to unravel the devastating truth after he stages his heroic death.

shows.title: Farsh se Arsh - Ek Udaan
shows.description: A powerful heir returns to his roots and is mistaken for a poor laborer, facing humiliation from those who value status over humanity. As his true identity is revealed, he rises to reclaim his dignity, reunite with his family, and expose deep-rooted class prejudice.

shows.title: Final Race
shows.description: Once a world champion racer, Sanjay loses everything after a sabotage by his envious adoptive brother Shourya, leading to his father’s death. Homeless and broken, Sanjay gets a new chance when Ananya rescues him and unknowingly hires him as a mechanic. As fate unfolds, Sanjay re-enters the racing world under disguise, restores his identity, and defeats Shourya in a breathtaking championship finale—redeeming his legacy and exposing his brother’s deceit. Watch now.

shows.title: Fate Ka Fighter
shows.description: A fallen prodigy rises from betrayal to reclaim his destiny in a world ruled by power and deception. Stripped of trust and left for dead, he returns stronger, sharper, and more dangerous than ever. As secrets unravel and loyalties shatter, every move becomes a battle for dominance. In this high-stakes game of ambition and revenge, will he conquer his fate or be consumed by it?

shows.title: Father's Last Wish
shows.description: Father's Last Wish is a romantic drama about Reet, a hardworking young woman who unknowingly falls for her late father's best friend and boss, Kartik Mehta - a powerful billionaire. What starts as a mentorship turns into love, betrayal, and redemption, as hidden truths, class differences and a toxic ex threaten to destroy their bond and their chance at happiness.

shows.title: Ghayal Ghatak Gabru
shows.description:
This is a story of revenge. Nivan’s sister is sexually assaulted, and shockingly, his own wife and her best friend help protect the culprit. Betrayed and shattered, Nivan sets out to take revenge for the injustice done to him and his family. In this journey, he is joined by Meera, his childhood friend, who stands by him.
In the end, both women realize their mistakes, but by then, Nivan has already moved on with his life.

shows.title: Fight For Love
shows.description: Anika Thakur is a college student who has to pay off huge debt to Maddy. In order to cancel the debt, Maddy asks her to work as secretary to a his rival Rich man Vikram and spy on Vikram's activities. Vikram has an incriminating secret, he fights in a illegal MMA club at night and works as suave CEO in the day. While spying for Maddy, Anika develops feelings for Vikram and it creates a conflict in her mind. As Vikram too falls for Anika, how both of them will fight for their love for each other

shows.title: Final 190 Minutes
